Set in the Burgundy region of High Medieval France. Each player is an aristocrat who starts with a small princedom and grows it by building settlements and mighty castles, trading along the river, working silver mines and using the knowledge of travellers.

This is the 2019 alea deluxe edition, which includes 8 mini expansions and a solo mode. Designed by Stefan Feld (original 2011).

Great for: players who enjoy planning and deep strategy.

description.en:
Set in the Burgundy region of High Medieval France. Each player is an aristocrat who starts with a small princedom and grows it by building settlements and mighty castles, trading along the river, working silver mines and using the knowledge of travellers.

The game runs over 5 phases of 5 rounds. Each round you roll two dice and use them to take tiles from the central board, place them in your princedom, sell goods or gain workers. Every tile triggers an effect when placed, so clever combos score big. Allow about 30 minutes per player. This is the original 2011 edition. Designed by Stefan Feld (2011).

Great for: players who enjoy planning and deep strategy.
